title: loot
summary: MSUI implements the current solo-loot and group-roll protocol surface, including exact CMSG_LOOT_ROLL bytes; strict START/ROLL/WON/ALL_PASSED parsing; vote-versus-dice disambiguation; winner placement; and ALL_PASSED's swapped property/suffix tail.

openItems.text: CMSG_LOOT_ROLL (u64 lootedTarget, u32 itemSlot, u8 rollType) has no sender
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: exact u64 target, u32 slot, u8 vote body is built, sent, and golden-byte checked.
2026-08-21: strict 28-byte START_ROLL parsing opens the four-frame client state with its server countdown.

openItems.text: SMSG_LOOT_ROLL not parsed, including the overloaded (roll_number, roll_type) vote-vs-dice disambiguation Benilla encodes in LootRoll::is_dice
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict 34-byte ROLL parsing implements the exact Need/Pass/Greed vote sentinels and 1..100 dice range.

openItems.text: SMSG_LOOT_ROLL_WON not parsed (winner guid rides AFTER the item block)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict 34-byte WON parsing reads the winner after the item block and closes the matching roll.

openItems.text: SMSG_LOOT_ALL_PASSED not parsed (note its swapped randomPropId/randomSuffix tail order)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: strict 24-byte ALL_PASSED parsing preserves its unique randomPropertyId-then-randomSuffix order.
